name: Gelatin, dried (from rendering)
source: Dried sheet/powder gelatin: illustrative proximate (per kg) water 120 g, protein 860 g, ash 20 g, negligible fat/carbohydrate — typical of commercial dried gelatin.
notes: Gelatin's protein is modelled by real published collagen/gelatin elemental analysis (C ~50.5%, H ~6.8%, N ~17.0%, O ~25.2%, S ~0.5%) rather than the generic protein factor used elsewhere in this dataset, because gelatin's glycine/proline/hydroxyproline-rich amino acid profile really does carry more nitrogen than a typical food protein. Ash is weighted toward calcium and phosphorus, reflecting a bone-derived rendering stock; a hide-derived stock would differ (a stated simplification — origin/gelatin.ts notes the same).
